results_seen_before_this_preregistration.interpretation: Ranking is stronger than frozen thresholded skill, and threshold values vary sharply across chronological folds. Threshold-estimation noise is now the bounded hypothesis.

model_contract.late_fusion_stacker: L2 logistic regression C=1.0 on calibration-role component logits only

threshold_policies.MAX_TSS: maximum TSS on threshold role; lowest-threshold tie break, existing policy
threshold_policies.POD80_MIN_FAR: among threshold-role thresholds achieving POD >= 0.80, choose the threshold with minimum FAR; highest threshold tie break
threshold_policies.BOOTSTRAP_MEDIAN_MAX_TSS: 1000 deterministic complete-unit bootstrap resamples of the threshold role; compute MAX_TSS threshold in each valid resample; deploy the median bootstrap threshold

decision_rule: A threshold policy may replace MAX_TSS in a future versioned benchmark only if it improves median fold TSS and pooled TSS for the same model without materially worsening pooled FAR or matched-detection FAR. Any benchmark-policy change must be versioned before locked-test access; this diagnostic itself cannot justify a final superiority claim.
forbidden: choosing a fourth threshold policy after seeing results
changing model hyperparameters within this experiment
retroactively altering the current frozen benchmark contract without a new version
